diagnosis.summary: BFCL tool instance globals reused across interleaved policy re-begin of the same entry_id. MultiTurnAgentSession.begin called execute_multi_turn_func_call([], initial_config, ...) with a stable model_name=probe_resident_{entry_id}; BFCL only _load_scenario when the globals() instance_name is absent, so policies 2+ inherited policy 1 mutated GorillaFileSystem. Not caused by cloud injection (slo_escalate: 0 cloud, $0).

divergence.expected: Empty warmup reloads initial_config (fresh entry semantics).
divergence.actual: Warmup reuses existing multi_turn_utils.globals() instance; no reset.
divergence.trigger: H1-3POLICY interleaved: for each entry, slo then emission then bounceback share one process and the same entry_id model_name.
divergence.fix: Unique model_name nonce per begin + explicit eviction before warmup (same uniqueness rule as score_multi_turn).

slo_escalate.note: First policy per entry; matches W-3 int4 baseline taxonomy (~20/200 pass, ~95 mismatch). Local turn-wise path healthy when begin gets a virgin globals slot.

emission_escalate.note: Quality collapse + excess escalations consistent with dirty BFCL world on re-begin; cloud path later dead (credit exhaustion).

salvage.slo_local_quality: Confirmatory only vs W-3 int4 6225d6e1 (20/200 pass; mismatch/empty/exec taxonomy aligned). Not a three-policy H1 result. Do not cite emission/bounceback numbers or session spend.
salvage.cloud_spend: Unusable after multi_turn_base_52 (tin=0/tout=0 streak). Motivates CLOUD_DEAD_PATH_GUARD N=3.
